dominant_breach: claimant lockout by fraud, data-broker, specialty-report, and identity-proofing infrastructure
fastest_washout: legal claim or account access denied before false-positive correction or assisted verification

score_mediated_exclusion_gate.note: Fraud and identity systems can protect programs, but they become a Gate 17 failure when false positives or stale broker data block legal claims without fast human correction.

data_broker_fraud_flag_lockout.note: Specialty reports and data-broker/FCRA perimeter instability make fraud flags an active exclusion risk rather than a mere compliance footnote.

identity_verification_access_and_error_c.note: GAO identity-proofing and fraud-risk evidence supports scoring both access failure and fraud-control necessity.

public_benefit_algorithmic_eligibility.note: Benefit modernization and fraud controls must prove that claimants can still convert legal eligibility into payment.

automated_decision_notice_explanation_ap.note: Automated fraud/identity flags require specific reasons, assisted channels, and timely review; otherwise correction is too late to preserve the claim.

data_minimization_and_retention_limits.note: Data retention and reuse limits remain proof debt where fraud signals can follow a person across systems.

score_repair_claimability.note: Repair must delete or suppress corrected fraud/identity signals across vendors and program interfaces, not only close a complaint. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: CFPB employment/background-score circular is now bound to score-mediated exclusion and correction rights.

fraud-control precision under organized group pressure

gate_17_score_mediated_exclusion.why: Gate 17 is blocked: fraud prevention is real, but certification requires multiple identity paths, specific notices, human review, urgent payment bridges, vendor deletion, and false-positive outcome data.

evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Map which vendors retain fraud/identity flags and prove deletion/suppression after correction across downstream systems.

evidence_debt_register.question: fraud-control precision under organized group pressure
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Separate controls aimed at organized fraud from broad-risk flags that sweep in low-documentation legitimate claimants.
